newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Sky City plans Sky Tower extravaganza.
newsitem.headline: Sky City plans Sky Tower extravaganza.

text.p: Sky City Ltd will put on a pyrotechnic display for Sunday to herald the opening of a its Sky Tower, the casino owner said on Friday.
Sunday's display would involve 44 tonnes of pyrotechnics and would outshine the spectacle seen at the recent Bledisloe Cup rugby union match in Melbourne, Sky City said.
Fireworks would be strategically placed around the city and harbour. The display will also involve high powered lasers.
Sky Tower looms large over Auckland's landscape and is one of the world's tallest buildings.
Sky City, which owns Auckland's only casino, is 63.1 percent owned by Brierley Investments.
